characters.name: Aemeath
characters.title: Synchronist of the Exostrider
characters.notes: Aemeath is a former Exostrider Synchronist of Rabelle College who became a digital ghost after synchronizing with the Exostrider. She now sings quietly amongst the stars while remaining deeply connected to the Exostrider.

characters.name: Carlotta
characters.title: The First Daughter of the Montelli Family
characters.notes: Carlotta is the eldest daughter of the Montelli family in Ragunna City. As a member of the prestigious Montelli family, she is known for her refined appearance, artistic talent, and powerful Glacio abilities.

characters.name: Rover
characters.title: Veil of Shadows
characters.notes: The protagonist of Wuthering Waves, an amnesiac Arbiter from another world who awakens with no memory of their past. Rover can resonate with multiple attributes and adapt their combat role accordingly.

characters.name: Denia
characters.title: Bubbles of Nihility
characters.notes: A Department of Voidmatters student at Startorch Academy and a professional slacker with an observant nature. Denia is known for her gentle smile and witty personality while possessing a deeper connection to the Fractsidus.

characters.name: Baizhi
characters.title: Healing You'tan
characters.notes: A researcher at Huaxu Academy specializing in Remnant Ecoacoustics and Remnant Energy. Her companion You'tan is closely connected to her research and provides her healing abilities.

characters.name: Hiyuki
characters.title: Futures' Tithe
characters.notes: A miko of the Flaming Sakura and a member of the Special Response Force. Having served as a miko for over a century, Hiyuki possesses unusual abilities connected to Suzu, one of the Legacy Talismans left behind by the Sentinels.

stats.affiliation: Special Response Force / Spacetrek Collective / Startorch Academy

characters.name: Galbrena
characters.title: Infernal Descent
characters.notes: A formidable Discord Slayer formerly known as Angel. Galbrena hunts Tacet Discords and can consume their frequencies and powers with the aid of Chimera. She now serves as a Consultant of the Black Shores.

characters.name: Jinhsi
characters.title: Thawborn Renewal
characters.notes: The young Magistrate of Jinzhou and the appointed Resonator of Sentinel Jue. Jinhsi carries the responsibility of protecting Jinzhou and guiding its future while wielding powerful Spectro abilities.

characters.name: Phoebe
characters.title: Graceful Luminescence
characters.notes: An Acolyte of the Order of the Deep known for her warmth, grace, devotion, and self-discipline. Phoebe carries out her duties with unwavering faith and offers compassion and comfort to those around her.

characters.name: Shorekeeper
characters.title: Euphonic Chrysalis
characters.notes: The guardian of the Black Shores and a mysterious divine being who has spent eons fulfilling her role. Her encounter with Rover awakens new emotions and desires within her, leading her to form a deeper connection with the world.

characters.name: Yangyang
characters.title: Breath of Winds
characters.notes: An outrider of the Midnight Rangers who can hear and perceive the sounds of the wind. Yangyang is one of Rover's earliest companions and is known for her gentle, attentive, and considerate personality.

characters.name: Yangyang: Xuanling
characters.title: Voices of Azure Plume
characters.notes: A 5-Star variant of Yangyang known as Xuanling. This form wields Havoc power and represents a significant evolution of Yangyang's combat capabilities.

characters.name: Zhezhi
characters.title: Enchanted Brush
characters.notes: A commissioned painter known for her quiet and shy personality. Zhezhi is deeply dedicated to her craft, and her paintings are brought to life through her Resonance abilities.

characters.name: Cartethyia
characters.title: Feathered Tempest
characters.notes: A wandering knight from Rinascita formerly revered as Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden. Cartethyia carries the powers of Sentinel Imperator and Threnodian Leviathan and seeks to live freely beyond the titles and expectations placed upon her.

characters.name: Changli
characters.title: Eternal Blaze
characters.notes: The former Secretary-General of the Central Secretariat in Mingting and the current Counselor to Jinzhou Magistrate Jinhsi. Changli is a patient and calculated strategist who excels at manipulating human nature and planning several steps ahead.

characters.name: Chisa
characters.title: Eye of Unravelling
characters.notes: A conscientious and level-headed student from Startorch Academy. Chisa approaches problems analytically and believes everything can be broken down and resolved, although human bonds remain the one thing she struggles to understand.

characters.name: Hsin
characters.notes: A newly revealed Wuthering Waves character. Hsin is confirmed as a 5-Star character, but her detailed combat information, element, weapon, role, birthday, affiliation, release date, and voice actors are not yet available.

characters.name: Suisui
characters.title: Bubbles of Prosperity
characters.notes: Born into a noble family of Mingting, Suisui is the brilliant young director of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild. She wields a water fan and uses her Resonance abilities to manipulate surrounding water and create graceful aquatic phenomena.

characters.name: Qingxiao
characters.title: The Sword Immortal
characters.notes: A reclusive sword immortal and nominal Cavalry Officer of the Zhenxuan Division under the Military Strategy Office of Xuanfang City. Qingxiao is renowned for her mastery of both the qin and sword and is surrounded by legends portraying her as an immortal guardian of the region.

characters.name: Lucilla
characters.title: President of Startorch Academy
characters.notes: The President of Startorch Academy and an idealist with both feet firmly on the ground. Lucilla quietly watches over her students as they strive to reach greater heights. She previously served as the editor-in-chief of an academic journal in the New Federation and worked with Mortefi.

characters.name: Aglaea
characters.title: The Goldweaver
characters.notes: The Goldweaver and Chrysos Heir bearing the Coreflame of Romance. Aglaea is a powerful Remembrance DPS who fights alongside her memosprite, Garmentmaker.

characters.name: Castorice
characters.title: Servant of Death
characters.notes: The Chrysos Heir bearing the Coreflame of Death. Castorice is the daughter of the River of Souls and commands the power of life and death alongside her memosprite Netherwing.

characters.name: Cyrene
characters.title: Daughter of Aedes Elysiae
characters.notes: The Chrysos Heir of Aedes Elysiae and a key figure of the Remembrance. Cyrene supports allies through powerful buffs and her unique Recollection mechanics.

characters.name: Firefly
characters.title: The Molten Knight
characters.notes: A young woman afflicted with Entropy Loss Syndrome who fights using the SAM armor. Firefly seeks a meaning for life while repeatedly confronting death through battle.

characters.name: Evanescia
characters.title: The Mysterious Lady
characters.notes: A mysterious lady who appears in Planarcadia like a fleeting season. Evanescia follows the Path of Elation and specializes in powerful Elation damage and Punchline mechanics.

characters.name: The Herta
characters.title: Madam Herta
characters.notes: The true Herta, a member of the Genius Society and the creator of the Herta Space Station. Unlike her puppet avatars, Madam Herta personally takes the field and wields overwhelming Erudition power.

characters.name: Himeko Nova
characters.title: Navigator of the Astral Express
characters.weapon: A Star That Lights the Night
characters.notes: A powerful new form of Himeko who follows the Path of Erudition. Himeko Nova specializes in Assist Skills, powerful follow-up attacks, and devastating Ultimate attacks while retaining her connection to the Astral Express.
tags: A Star That Lights the Night

characters.name: Hysilens
characters.title: Daughter of the Sea
characters.notes: The Chrysos Heir of Styxia and a master of oceanic power. Hysilens follows the Path of Nihility and specializes in damage-over-time effects, applying multiple DoT types to enemies.

characters.name: Jade
characters.title: The Pave of Debt
characters.notes: A senior manager of the IPC Strategic Investment Department and one of the Ten Stonehearts. Jade is an elegant and calculating moneylender who specializes in extracting value from seemingly hopeless investments.

characters.name: Jingliu
characters.title: Transcendent Flash
characters.weapon: I Shall Be My Own Sword
characters.notes: The former Sword Champion of the Xianzhou and Jing Yuan's master. Jingliu became mara-struck and now walks the path of the sword while suppressing the madness within her.
tags: I Shall Be My Own Sword

characters.name: Lingsha
characters.title: The Fragrant Smoke
characters.notes: The Vidyadhara Cauldron Master of the Xianzhou Luofu. Lingsha is a skilled healer who uses incense and her companion Fuyuan to provide healing and follow-up attacks.

characters.name: March 7th • Evernight
characters.title: Evernight
characters.notes: An alternate Remembrance form of March 7th encountered during the Amphoreus journey. Evernight is a powerful HP-scaling Remembrance damage dealer who fights alongside her memosprite.

characters.name: Phainon
characters.title: Worldbearing
characters.notes: The Chrysos Heir carrying the Coreflame of Worldbearing. Phainon is a powerful Destruction character whose Ultimate transforms the battlefield and isolates him as the primary combatant.

characters.name: Robin
characters.title: The Halovian Singer
characters.notes: A Halovian singer born in Penacony who achieved cosmic fame. Robin follows the Path of Harmony and provides powerful teamwide buffs and action advancement through her music.

characters.name: Silver Wolf • LV.999
characters.title: The Invincible Player
characters.notes: A new Elation form of Silver Wolf, presented as an invincible player who has conquered every level and Cosmic Achievement. Unlike her original Nihility form, LV.999 follows the Path of Elation and focuses on high-speed Elation damage.

characters.name: Sparkle
characters.title: Masked Fool
characters.notes: A dangerous and unpredictable member of the Masked Fools. Sparkle is a master of deception and theatrics who follows the Path of Harmony and manipulates the battlefield through powerful buffs and Skill Point mechanics.

characters.name: The Dahlia
characters.title: Constance
characters.notes: Known as Constance, The Dahlia is a powerful Nihility support focused on Break and Super Break teams. She can convert Toughness Reduction into Super Break damage and provide powerful Break-oriented debuffs.

characters.name: Tingyun • Fugue
characters.title: Fugue
characters.notes: A new form of Tingyun following the Path of Nihility. Fugue specializes in Break teams, providing Weakness manipulation, Break Effect support, and powerful debuffs against enemies.

characters.name: Yao Guang
characters.title: Seer Strategist
characters.notes: A mysterious and radical Seer Strategist associated with the Path of the Hunt. Yao Guang follows the Path of Elation and specializes in amplifying Elation teams through Zones, Punchline generation, and powerful team buffs.

characters.name: Welt
characters.title: Yang
characters.weapon: In the Name of the World
characters.notes: The former Anti-Entropy Sovereign and a veteran who has repeatedly saved Earth from destruction. Welt joined the Astral Express and continues his journey across worlds while wielding powerful Imaginary abilities.
tags: In the Name of the World

characters.name: Scarlet
characters.title: Black Blade
characters.notes: A member of the Pioneer squad and one of the legendary Grimms Models. Scarlet is a swordswoman who fights with her signature blade while sacrificing HP to greatly increase her offensive power.

characters.name: Diesel: Winter Sweets
characters.title: Sweet Songstress
characters.notes: A winter-themed version of Diesel, the AZX attendant. Diesel: Winter Sweets is an Attacker who uses her singing and sustained damage abilities to overwhelm enemies.

characters.name: Dorothy
characters.title: Goddess of Victory
characters.notes: The leader of the Goddess squad and a Grimms Model who once fought alongside the original Goddess of Victory. Dorothy possesses immense power and carries deep resentment toward humanity after the events surrounding the Ark.

characters.name: Flora
characters.title: Botanic Gardener
characters.notes: A member of the Botanic Garden squad who specializes in plant cultivation and support. Flora continuously heals herself and nearby allies and can provide shields and True Damage support.

characters.name: Moran
characters.title: The Tiger
characters.notes: The leader of the Underworld Queen squad. Moran is a straightforward and fiercely loyal fighter who specializes in surviving heavy damage, taunting enemies, and protecting her allies.

characters.name: Snow White: Innocent Days
characters.title: Innocent Days
characters.notes: Snow White in her younger days, before becoming the hardened warrior of Pioneer. Innocent Days is a Pilgrim Attacker who fights with the Seven Dwarves weapon system.

characters.name: Takina Inoue
characters.title: Lycoris
characters.notes: An outstanding Lycoris from Café LycoReco who joins NIKKE through the Lycoris Recoil collaboration. Takina is a Supporter who boosts allies, weakens enemies, and can deal True Damage during Burst.

characters.name: Scarlet: Black Shadow
characters.title: Black Shadow
characters.notes: A younger and more ruthless incarnation of Scarlet. Black Shadow uses a Rocket Launcher and specializes in extremely high single-target damage, charge attacks, and distributed damage.

characters.name: Arcane
characters.title: Operator
characters.notes: A master of ancient Arts manipulation fighting for infected rights.

characters.name: Laevatain
characters.title: Surtr / Flame Wielder
characters.notes: An enigmatic Sarkaz swordswoman carrying giant fiery phantom blades.

characters.name: Last Rite
characters.title: Operator
characters.notes: A quiet Sankta markswoman executing final rites on battlefield targets.

characters.name: Perlica
characters.title: Endfield Supervisor
characters.notes: Supervisor of Endfield Industries on planet Talos-II.

characters.name: Zhuang Fangyi
characters.title: Operator
characters.notes: A martial artist from Yan adept at rapid vanguard deployment.

characters.name: Xaihi

characters.name: Lone Planetfarer
characters.title: Battlesuit: Lone Planetfarer
characters.notes: The enigmatic wanderer traveling through planetary ruins in the Sea of Quanta.

characters.name: Chiori
characters.title: The Thundering Seamstress
characters.notes: A renowned fashion designer from Inazuma who established Chioriya Boutique in Fontaine. Chiori specializes in creating elegant and distinctive clothing while maintaining a sharp and straightforward personality.

characters.name: Columbina
characters.title: Moon Maiden
characters.notes: Known as the Moon Maiden, Columbina is a mysterious character associated with Frost Moon and the Three Moons. She was formerly one of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers and now plays an important role in Nod-Krai's lunar-related phenomena.

characters.name: Keqing
characters.title: Driving Thunder
characters.notes: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing strongly believes in taking action through her own efforts rather than relying entirely on the guidance of the gods. She is known for her efficiency, determination, and dedication to Liyue.

characters.name: Skirk
characters.title: Void Star
characters.notes: A mysterious swordswoman from the sea of stars and Tartaglia's former master. Skirk is the disciple of Surtalogi, one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, and is associated with the Cosmic Calamity. Her origins are not officially assigned to a specific nation.

characters.name: Diluc
characters.title: The Dark Side of Dawn
characters.notes: The owner of the Dawn Winery and one of Mondstadt's most powerful figures. After losing his father, Diluc became a vigilante who protects Mondstadt from threats while operating from the shadows.

characters.name: Roslyn
characters.title: The Dedicated Special Officer
characters.notes: A dedicated new special officer of the Federation with a strong sense of responsibility. Roslyn strives to become an enthusiastic, approachable, and competent model officer while caring deeply for her friends.

characters.name: Yan Miao
characters.title: The Yuheng of Department of Yuheng
characters.notes: A young researcher who became the head of the Department of Yuheng. Yan Miao has made outstanding achievements in researching Darkness and strives to restore the department's reputation.

characters.name: Fei Se
characters.title: The Darkshadow
characters.notes: A powerful Flame Simulacrum associated with Endless Bloom. Fei Se uses flower-based abilities and Mirage Fantasy mechanics to create Phantasias and Lotus Petals while dealing sustained Flame damage.

characters.name: Fiona
characters.title: The Archon of Innars
characters.notes: The current Archon of the undersea city Innars. Fiona is calm, highly perceptive, and exceptionally capable of devising strategies during crises. Her Moonstar Bracelet is an Altered Support weapon capable of supporting multiple resonance types.

characters.name: Lin
characters.title: The Mirroria Idol
characters.notes: A renowned Executor of Mirroria and a highly respected figure among its residents. Lin is known for her strict standards, cleanliness, and strong sense of responsibility. She was the first Simulacrum to wield Altered Damage.
